instruction: Locate information about commercial driver's license (CDL) requirements in Virginia

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to navigate from Virginia DMV homepage to the commercial driver's license (CDL) page. Evaluator checks if the final URL matches the expected pattern for commercial or CDL pages. Uses existing getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree address bar element
Metric correctly applies regex pattern matching to verify URL matches expected CDL page patterns
Complete instruction coverage: evaluator verifies navigation to CDL information pages
Expected regex pattern is semantically correct: matches both /commercial and /licenses-ids/cdl paths on dmv.virginia.gov
Practical feasibility confirmed: getter can access URL state without postconfig, metric can perform regex matching
Proper edge case handling: handles None/empty results, both string and dict URL formats
